name: Tyrannosaurus rex
fact: It had one of the strongest bites of any land animal ever!

name: Triceratops
fact: Its giant neck frill may have helped it show off to other Triceratops.

name: Stegosaurus
fact: The spikes on its tail have a funny nickname: the 'thagomizer'!

name: Brachiosaurus
fact: Its front legs were longer than its back legs, just like a giraffe.

name: Velociraptor
fact: It was covered in feathers and was about as big as a turkey.

name: Ankylosaurus
fact: It was covered in bony armor, like a tank, and swung a heavy club on its tail.

name: Spinosaurus
fact: It had a giant sail on its back and spent lots of time in rivers catching fish.

name: Diplodocus
fact: Its super-long tail may have cracked like a whip!

name: Parasaurolophus
fact: The long tube on its head may have worked like a trumpet to make loud honks.

name: Pachycephalosaurus
fact: The bony dome on top of its head was up to 10 inches thick!

name: Allosaurus
fact: It lived about 80 million years before T. rex was even around.

name: Iguanodon
fact: It had big spiky thumbs, maybe for defense or for grabbing food.

name: Compsognathus
fact: It was about the size of a chicken and ate lizards and bugs.

name: Argentinosaurus
fact: It was one of the biggest animals ever to walk on land.

name: Microraptor
fact: It had feathered wings on its arms AND its legs: four wings!
